PHASE.NAME: UPGRADE_2 A1 Self-Heal Foundation
PHASE.GOAL: Implement bounded self-heal as the core autonomous verify, diagnose, fix, and re-verify loop.

DATA_FLOWS.FLOW: RunActionKind::SelfHeal invokes verification, converts failures into diagnoses, persists SelfHealPlan, and records provenance.
MCP self_heal exposes the same bounded loop to agents without losing failure context between tool calls.

STEPS.step-1: Created SelfHealPlan, SelfHealDiagnosis, SelfHealResult, and run metadata persistence helpers.
STEPS.step-2: Added RunActionKind::SelfHeal and async-safe execution path for self-heal iterations.
STEPS.step-3: Added self_heal handler and wired it through MCP request routing.
STEPS.step-4: Exposed self_heal tool schema with run_id and profile arguments.

RISKS.RISK: Self-heal must be capped by retry budget to avoid infinite repair loops.
Self-heal must report diagnosis and escalation clearly when it cannot safely fix the failure.
